retained_scope: Canonical frozen source/protocol/model pins, native results, complete error evidence, independent scoring code, structured final verification and scientific limitations.
documentation_change: Concise methodological correction and public-scope explanations replace redundant development material.
excluded_scope: Redundant developer comparisons, duplicate runtime/reference inventories and operational bookkeeping.
provenance_policy: Scope-only public provenance; no private predecessor identifiers or omission hashes.
